summary_en: 60M shares (2.1% of S/O ex-treasury) and ¥200B upper limit. Open-market purchase Aug 5, 2026–Jan 29, 2027. All acquired shares to be cancelled Feb 5, 2027. Purpose: shareholder return expansion and capital-efficiency improvement.
title_en: Resolution on Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On August 4, 2026, Mitsui & Co.'s board resolved to acquire up to 60 million common shares and to cancel all acquired shares. The acquisition will proceed via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from August 5, 2026 through January 29, 2027, with an upper limit of ¥200 billion. All treasury shares acquired under this program are to be cancelled on February 5, 2027. The stated rationale is expansion of shareholder returns and improvement in capital efficiency. The share count represents 2.1% of the 2,848,191,964 shares outstanding (excluding treasury) as of June 30, 2026.
